ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I chose Petrel because the query is a straightforward creative writing task (drafting a job description) with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content, so neither model's flat-aversion task preference is relevant. The deciding factor was capability: Petrel scores meaningfully higher on the metrics that matter for this task — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6, relevant since the user wants instruction-following and a "usable" result), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4). Those gaps exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold, so Petrel is the clearly stronger fit.
